_comment: Staff phone directory for WhatsApp routing. Match key is phone9 — the last 9 digits, same normalization as normalizePhone() in whatsapp/ingest/phone.js (strips 972 / leading zeros). 'inAllGroups: true' marks the partner who is a participant of every group (Yaakov Epstein) and must be ignored when picking the responsible staff member. 'defaultOwner' names the admin who receives anything that can't be routed.
